ranking.reason: Losing a lecture recording is an acute, easy-to-picture fear, and a promise to keep it safe on the phone can be shown in a single ad.
Losing a flashcard deck is a concrete, costly failure, but the free incumbent Anki and the need for import/export as a feature limit how many people will pay to switch.
Lost sets and wrong-exercise jumps are real frustrations for Apple Watch lifters, but the audience is narrower and several competitors already cover logging.
Learners want fair pronunciation scoring, but large established brands dominate the category and an ad cannot easily prove that the judgement is accurate.
Keto and low-carb users want exact label values and will tap a targeted ad, but MyFitnessPal and Cronometer already serve this need and the 'no AI guess' angle is a narrow differentiator.
Students want study help from their own notes, but free general-purpose LLMs such as ChatGPT and NotebookLM are strong substitutes that reduce the reason to tap a paid app ad.
